# Caladea 1.002

Cambria-compatible Latin fallback, Copyright (c) 2012 Huerta Tipografia, Apache-2.0.

Bundled by [DocViewKit](../../README.md) under its original font license. Retain [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt), Huerta Tipografia's copyright notice and the pinned hashes below when redistributing these four faces. Release validation checks the exact reviewed files and includes their license in each artifact.

Unmodified font files from the LibreOffice bundled crosextra Caladea distribution (`crosextrafonts-20130214`). Newer Google Fonts Caladea versions have different advances and are not interchangeable. Only missing Cambria faces load these same-origin packaged files; document fonts, host fonts, exact local faces, and provider fonts retain priority.

Upstream: https://cgit.freedesktop.org/libreoffice/core/tree/external/more_fonts/ExternalPackage_crosextra_caladea.mk

Source archive: https://dev-www.libreoffice.org/src/368f114c078f94214a308a74c7e991bc-crosextrafonts-20130214.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256: `c48d1c2fd613c9c06c959c34da7b8388059e2408d2bb19845dc3ed35f76e4d09`.
All four files were compared byte-for-byte with this archive. The font name table identifies Huerta Tipografia as copyright holder and Apache License 2.0 as the license. The archive contains only the fonts; LICENSE.txt preserves that copyright notice and the official https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt text.
